title: Gotsman–Linial product on the cube
statement: For natural numbers $n,a,d$ and a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, define a real-valued function by taking the product over $j=0,\ldots,d-1$ of $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\operatorname{sgn}(x_i)-\bigl(2(a+j)-n+1\bigr)$, where $\operatorname{sgn}(x_i)$ is the sign value of coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
caveat: The payload does not define the sign-value convention, though the product formula is explicit.
